method: Provider-free: scripts/quality/test-dig-live.mjs calls dig_to over the bridge; between calls it stands in for the model: a cave, lava or loose-block stop turns 90 degrees, HOSTILE_NEAR removes the sensed monsters by command (a fight stand-in) and goes on, TOOL_WORN gives a stone pickaxe (a crafting stand-in) or turns away from an ore only an iron pickaxe harvests, a body of water ends the spot as the model's decision. Kit: iron pickaxe + stone pickaxe, the checkpoint's other items. Before = round 1 (6a393dc2, same spots; it stopped at caves and water). Times are digging seconds (sum of dig_to calls); model turns between calls are not included.
